_comment: Family events (#/family/events). Upcoming ones (date today or later) show first, soonest on top; past ones move to 'Past gatherings' on their own. Times are 24-hour 'HH:MM'. 'menu' groups are free text. 'bringing' on a dish is optional — leave it out until someone claims it. 'requests': true shows the request form on that event; it stays switched off until EVENTS_ENDPOINT in assets/app.js is set (see SETUP-EVENTS.md). 'rsvps' is the running guest list shown under 'Who's coming': {"name", "count", "status": "yes"|"maybe"|"no", "note"}.
